# Lubei Group: new titanium dioxide distribution agreement with Emsa Tecnología Química

## 08 July 2026

## COATINGS, REPRESENTADAS

At Emsa Tecnología Química, we continue to strengthen our network of international manufacturers to bring high-performance raw materials to the Iberian market, backed by close technical support and specialist expertise. As part of this commitment, we have entered into a distribution agreement with Lubei Group, a leading manufacturer of titanium dioxide (TiO₂), for the Spanish market.

This agreement combines Lubei Group‘s extensive experience in titanium dioxide manufacturing with our expertise in TiO₂ distribution across Spain. Together, we share a common goal: to provide the market with competitive solutions, responsive service, and the technical support required by today’s formulations.

### A partnership focused on industry

Lubei Group has extensive production capacity and a highly integrated manufacturing operation, producing titanium dioxide for applications where quality, batch-to-batch consistency, and performance are essential.

With this new partnership, we are expanding our portfolio to better meet the needs of manufacturers and formulators in sectors such as coatings, plastics, masterbatch, inks, and other industrial applications.

### A product range designed for different applications

Lubei Group’s titanium dioxide portfolio includes a variety of grades manufactured using both the sulfate and chloride processes, allowing us to meet the specific technical requirements of different applications.

Through this collaboration, Emsa offers the market a broader titanium dioxide portfolio, supported by the technical and commercial expertise needed to help customers identify the most suitable solution for each project.

Discover the Lubei Group titanium dioxide range available through Emsa Tecnología Química by clicking here.

### General description

Nuestro nanopolvo de óxido de titanio (IV) es un polvo blanco fino compuesto por nanopartículas de dióxido de titanio con un tamaño de partícula promedio de 21 nm, que produce una gran superficie de 35-65 m^{2}/g. Dos principales polimorfos físico-químicamente distintos del TiO_{2} son la anatasa y el rutilo. La anatasa tiene una actividad fotocatalítica más alta que el rutilo, pero es termodinámicamente menos estable.[1]

We are committed to bringing you Greener Alternative Products that adhere to one of the four categories of Greener Alternatives. ### Application

Se utilizaron nanopartículas de TiO_{2} para estudiar la degradación fotocatalítica del vapor de hexano. Se ha utilizado como adsorbente para la eliminación del arsénico. Las nanopartículas TiO_{2} son adecuadas para la rehabilitación de los componentes antisépticos en aguas residuales por fotocatálisis. También se ha utilizado para estudiar la adsorción de los oligonucleótidos del ADN por nanopartículas de dióxido de titanio.PMID 24387035

# Titanium Dioxide - An important white pigment for many products

## Titanium Dioxide - White Pigments

Titanium Dioxide TiO2 is an exceptional chemical compound due to its ultra-white color. In addition to its ability to scatter and reflect light, TiO2 is resistant to UV radiation and can absorb it as well.

Titanium Dioxide is therefore found in many essential everyday products (e.g. sunscreens) and makes a significant contribution to improving the quality of life and facilitating economic growth.

TER Chemicals offers a vast application experience in specialty chemicals and has a long history as a titanium dioxide supplier. 

## [Button: Properties of titanium dioxide]

Titanium dioxide (TiO2), also known as food additive E171, is an oxide of titanium. The chemical compound is insoluble in water and has an extremely high melting point (1843 degrees Celsius) and boiling point (2972 degrees Celsius).

Titanium dioxide is a powder and is among the whitest and brightest pigments available. However, this is not the only property that makes it so versatile.

White pigments usually appear slightly yellowish. But titanium dioxide is able to absorb UV radiation so well that it has a pure white appearance. Moreover, the ultrafine chemical can act as a photocatalyst to reduce the amount of pollutants in the environment.

Titanium dioxide has a higher refractive index than diamonds. It is therefore very widely used in the production of cosmetics and personal care products (e.g. sunscreen).

Titanium dioxide can be produced as either pigments or nan-sized particles. Both forms of TiO2 are tasteless and odorless and are insoluble in water.

Feel free to approach TER Chemicals to find out more about our TiO2 products. As an experienced supplier of specialty chemicals we can support you with our application expertise.

## [Button: Occurrence of titanium dioxide]

There are three naturally occurring forms of titanium oxide (TiO2): rutile, anatase and brookite. Each of these polymorphs has its own crystal structure and density.

In addition to the three naturally occurring forms, there are another eight forms of titanium dioxide that can be produced synthetically.
